name: azarin-ajor
description: Azarin Ajor - Frontend and Backend Monorepo

scripts.build: pnpm --filter back build && pnpm --filter front build
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter back clean && pnpm --filter front clean
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter back lint && pnpm --filter front lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter back test && pnpm --filter front test
